capabilities.title: Frame from a grid
capabilities.prompt: Build a concrete frame on a {bays_x} by {bays_y} grid at {spacing} m, columns on every story and beams on every grid line, with the sections already in the model. Tell me what you assumed before you build.

capabilities.title: Model from a CAD plan
capabilities.prompt: I attached a CAD plan. Read its layers, tell me which hold the grids, columns and walls, and after I confirm build the columns, walls and beams on all stories.

capabilities.title: Model from a PDF drawing
capabilities.prompt: I attached a structural drawing as PDF. Read the grid spacings, member sizes and story heights, list them with what you estimated, and build the model after I confirm.

capabilities.title: Add a typical floor slab
capabilities.prompt: Add slabs on {story} between the grid lines, using the slab section already in the model, and tell me the total area.

capabilities.title: Fix the base
capabilities.prompt: Set fixed supports under every column and wall at the base and tell me how many points you restrained.

capabilities.title: Change the selected sections
capabilities.prompt: Change the selected beams to {section} and read back how many changed.

capabilities.title: Core walls
capabilities.prompt: Add the core walls on all stories along these lines: {lines}. Use the wall section already in the model.

capabilities.title: Standard load patterns
capabilities.prompt: Add the load patterns Dead, SDL, Live and Roof Live if they are missing, and list all patterns with their types.

capabilities.title: Floor loads
capabilities.prompt: Apply {sdl} kN/m² superimposed dead and {live} kN/m² live load to every slab on the typical stories and read back the totals per story.

capabilities.title: Wall loads on beams
capabilities.prompt: Apply a line load of {load} kN/m for partition walls on the perimeter beams of every story.

capabilities.title: Strength combinations
capabilities.prompt: Add the strength combinations for dead, superimposed dead and live load to the code this model is set to, and list them with their factors.

capabilities.title: Check the loads
capabilities.prompt: List every load pattern with the total load assigned to frames and slabs, and point out stories with no live load.

capabilities.title: Run and summarise
capabilities.prompt: Run the analysis and give me the base reactions per load pattern and the first three periods.

capabilities.title: Story drifts
capabilities.prompt: Read the story drifts for every lateral case, give the largest per direction with its story, and compare it with {limit}.

capabilities.title: Base reactions for foundations
capabilities.prompt: Give me the support reactions per column for the service combinations as an Excel file, one row per support.

capabilities.title: Modal results
capabilities.prompt: Read the modal periods and mass participation, and tell me how many modes reach 90 % in each direction.

capabilities.title: Largest member forces
capabilities.prompt: From the frame force tables, list the ten beams with the largest moment under the governing strength combination.

capabilities.title: Model health check
capabilities.prompt: Check this model for the usual problems: members with no section, duplicated or overlapping members, unsupported columns, stories with no loads, and points with no restraint at the base.

capabilities.title: Full check report
capabilities.prompt: Run the full check report on the results: modes, drift against {limit}, torsion, soft story and mass, and the design ratios. One line per check, then the members that fail.

capabilities.title: Torsion and irregularity
capabilities.prompt: Check torsional irregularity and soft or heavy stories from the results, and tell me which stories and load cases govern.

capabilities.title: Design ratios
capabilities.prompt: Read ETABS's design summaries and list every member with a ratio above {limit}, with its story, section and governing combination.

capabilities.title: Snapshot and compare
capabilities.prompt: Take a snapshot of the model now called {name}. After my changes I will ask you to compare, and you tell me what changed in the model and in the results.

capabilities.title: Quantities
capabilities.prompt: Give me concrete volume and member counts per story for columns, beams, walls and slabs, as a table.

capabilities.title: What changed since analysis
capabilities.prompt: Is the analysis up to date? Tell me whether the model is locked and what I would lose by unlocking it.

capabilities.title: Compare with the drawings
capabilities.prompt: Compare the column sizes in this model with the attached schedule and list every difference by story and grid.

capabilities.title: Review pack for a colleague
capabilities.prompt: Make a review pack of this model with its results and checks, for a colleague who has no ETABS. Drift limit {limit}.

capabilities.title: Answer review comments
capabilities.prompt: Read the review comments in the attached file, select each member they are about, and tell me what you find for each one.

capabilities.title: Calculation note
capabilities.prompt: Write a short calculation note in Word for this model: description, materials, sections, loads, combinations and the main results, with tables.

capabilities.title: Section schedule to Excel
capabilities.prompt: Make an Excel schedule of every frame section with how many members use it and their total length, by story.

capabilities.title: Column layout to CAD
capabilities.prompt: Draw the column layout of {story} as a DWG file, with column names as text.

capabilities.title: Results summary as PDF
capabilities.prompt: Make a one-page PDF with the base reactions, periods and maximum drifts.

capabilities.title: What is in this model?
capabilities.prompt: What is in this model? Stories, main members with counts, load patterns and whether it has been analysed.

capabilities.title: Select by section
capabilities.prompt: Select every beam with section {section} so I can see them in ETABS.

capabilities.title: Find long beams
capabilities.prompt: List the beams longer than {length} m with their story and section.

capabilities.title: Save this as a recipe
capabilities.prompt: Save the steps we just did as a recipe I can run on another model, with the values that change as placeholders.

capabilities.title: Is everything working?
capabilities.prompt: Run the self test and tell me in plain words what works and what does not.

capabilities.title: Remember a standard
capabilities.prompt: Remember that {rule}. Use it in every model from now on.

tailored.title: Quick scheme model
tailored.prompt: Build a quick scheme model of this building from what I describe: grid, story heights, typical sections and loads. State every assumption first.

tailored.title: Compare two grids
tailored.prompt: Build the frame on the grid I give, report the weight and the largest beam span, then tell me what changes with the second grid.

tailored.title: First loads
tailored.prompt: Add the usual load patterns and typical floor loads for this use, and say which values you assumed so I can correct them.

tailored.title: Model from the drawings
tailored.prompt: Read the attached drawings (PDF or CAD), list grids, story heights and member sizes, and build the model after I confirm.

tailored.title: Lateral system first look
tailored.prompt: Run the analysis and give me periods, base shears and story drifts per direction, and say where the structure is soft.

tailored.title: Size check overview
tailored.prompt: List every section with its count and the largest force it carries, and point out members that look undersized or oversized.

tailored.title: Load combinations
tailored.prompt: Add the full set of strength and service combinations to the code this model is set to, and list them.

tailored.title: Foundation reactions
tailored.prompt: Give the support reactions per column for service and strength combinations as an Excel file for the foundation design.

tailored.title: Drift and stability
tailored.prompt: Read story drifts and tell me the largest per direction with its story and combination, against the limit I give.

tailored.title: Update sections from a schedule
tailored.prompt: Change the member sections to match the attached schedule, and list what changed by story.

tailored.title: Model check before issue
tailored.prompt: Check the model: unassigned sections, duplicates, unsupported members, stories without loads, missing combinations. One line per finding.

tailored.title: Compare with the drawings

tailored.title: Supports and restraints
